prompt: 给标讯详情页加一个分享功能。用户点击分享按钮，弹出一个对话框，里面有复制链接按钮和扫码二维码。这是一个纯前端功能，不需要后端改动。用 speckit 流程快速实现。

assertions.name: skill-invoked
assertions.description: The with-skill test invokes the speckit-chain skill
assertions.check: summary.md mentions 'speckit-chain' or Skill tool invocation

assertions.name: constitution-executed
assertions.check: .specify/memory/constitution.md exists or summary mentions constitution step

assertions.name: spec-created
assertions.description: Specification was generated for the share feature
assertions.check: A spec.md file exists under specs/ directory or summary mentions spec generation

assertions.name: plan-created
assertions.check: A plan.md file exists under specs/ directory or summary mentions plan generation

assertions.name: frontend-only
assertions.description: Plan correctly identifies this as a frontend-only change
assertions.check: Summary or plan indicates no backend changes needed

assertions.name: tasks-created
assertions.check: A tasks.md file exists or summary mentions task generation

assertions.name: no-backend-tasks
assertions.description: Tasks don't include backend implementation tasks
assertions.check: Task breakdown doesn't mention backend/controller/service for the share feature
